'''2009 Worlds Day 3 Brian Hunter LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' Hunter
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
